## SETUP + PURPOSE

Turns long-form text into a concise executive summary, key points, decisions, risks, and action items. It runs locally in demo mode and can later be upgraded to an LLM node.

nodes.name: COMPLETE SYSTEMS → AI Summarization Workflow Webhook

assignments.name: prompt
assignments.value:
={{ `You are an expert executive assistant.

Analyze the document below and return ONLY valid JSON.

Use this exact schema:

{
  "executiveSummary": "",
  "keyPoints": [],
  "decisions": [],
  "actionItems": [],
  "risks": [],
  "nextSteps": []
}

Document Title:
${$json.document.title}

Document:
${$json.document.text}` }}

parameters.content:
**WHAT IT DOES:**
Automatically converts long-form text such as meeting notes, reports, emails, or documents into a concise AI-generated summary with key points, decisions, action items, risks, and next steps.

**HOW IT DOES IT:**
Accepts text through a manual trigger or webhook, prepares the input and AI prompt, sends it to GPT-5 mini for analysis, then processes the results into a structured business-ready output.

**WHY PAY FOR IT:**
Saves teams hours of manual reading and note-taking, reduces the chance of important information being missed, standardizes documentation, and helps employees turn large amounts of information into clear, actionable insights faster.
